up: Retrieve all activity records from the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1614227'. For each activity record, provide the canonical SMILES of the tested compound (from the compound_structures table), the compound ChEMBL ID (from the molecule_dictionary table), and the standard activity type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units from the activities table. Include all activity rows; do not filter by relation or any other condition outside the assay identifier.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614227';
